advisoryFindings.title: R3 finding content assertions are light
advisoryFindings.improvement: Assert that the persisted flow-findings entries preserve the durable finding payload identity, such as guardrail IDs or reasons, not only entry count and source metadata.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The test still exercises production behavior for semantic deferral, verifies two persisted entries, unique source finding IDs, gate completion, unchanged retry count, and no provider invocation; the extra assertions would strengthen traceability but are not required to establish coverage.
